Company Overview

ID.me is the next-generation digital identity wallet that simplifies how individuals securely prove their identity online. Heartflow is a medical technology company advancing the diagnosis and management of coronary artery disease, the #1 cause of death worldwide, using cutting-edge technology. jobs.description_text:
About the job

Build your first real systems engineering experience on AI hardware you can measure, test and improve.

As a Systems Engineering Intern in Austin, you will contribute to projects across hardware, firmware and software engineering. You will help validate advanced AI compute platforms from subsystem behaviour to full system performance.

You will support CPU and high-speed input and output subsystem work, including lab testing, automation and data analysis. Your work will help engineers understand performance, power, signal behaviour and reliability.

You will gain hands-on experience with technologies such as PCIe 6.0, 800G Ethernet and high-performance cooling. You will own defined technical tasks with guidance, then document your methods, results and conclusions.

This internship is a chance to turn academic learning into practical engineering judgement on real AI hardware.

The team and culture

You will join systems engineers who work across hardware, firmware, software, mechanical and thermal teams. Work happens through lab measurement, script-driven validation, shared debugging and clear engineering notes.

You will be given defined problems to own, with guidance from engineers who expect curiosity and careful thinking. Decisions are made through data, reproducible results and open technical review.

Job Title: Scrum Master

Location: Atlanta, GA, New York, NY, or Remote

Employment Type: Full-time, Salaried

 

Who We Are

Impiricus is at the forefront of transforming the pharmaceutical industry. Our mission is to innovate the way pharmaceutical companies connect with physicians, enhancing the communication channels that are critical for the advancement of healthcare. With a team dedicated to pushing the boundaries of digital solutions, we aim to improve patient outcomes by fostering more effective, data-driven interactions between healthcare professionals and drug manufacturers. Join us in our journey to revolutionize healthcare communication and make a lasting impact on the industry.

Job Summary:

We are seeking a self-started, highly motivated Scrum Master to join our dynamic team at Impiricus. In this role, you will facilitate agile practices and principles while supporting our mission to revolutionize healthcare communication through innovative digital solutions. This role ensures our HR operations are compliant, secure, data-driven, and built to scale, while also providing a seamless employee experience. This is a hands-on individual contributor role partnering with cross-functional stakeholders and building the foundation of our core HR functions including compensation, benefits, HRIS, payroll, and compliance.  This role will report to Vice President, Talent Management.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description_text:
Lightspeed Systems is seeking an Account Manager, to own the post-sale relationship for a dedicated book of mid-market K-12 school district accounts. This role is responsible for retention, expansion, and making sure customers are getting real value out of their Lightspeed products - you are the primary point of contact for your customers for the life of the contract.
This is not a prospecting role. You don't chase new logos - you protect and grow what Lightspeed already has. When a new Account Executive closes a deal in your book, you're the one who takes the relationship from there.

Key Responsibilities
  • Own a named list of assigned accounts with defined renewal dates as the customer's primary point of contact.
  • Drive all renewal activity from first outreach through signed order, and proactively flag at-risk accounts before they become churn.
  • Identify and close expansion and upsell opportunities within your book - additional products, increased seat counts, multi-year conversions.
  • Maintain accurate, current Salesforce records on every account in your book - opportunity stage, renewal health, next steps, and contacts.
  • Spot at-risk accounts early and escalate promptly, rather than waiting for a renewal to be in jeopardy.
  • Conduct regular account review meetings designed to surface expansion opportunity and reduce churn risk, not just handle support issues.

jobs.description_text:
About Us

Madison Energy Infrastructure is hiring a Director of Battery Asset Management to build and run the operating platform behind our national, distributed, battery fleet. We have 80 MW of batteries operating today across 30 sites and 5 states, expect that fleet to triple next year and double the following year, with $2 billion of battery deployment ahead of us. The goal is simple: get the operating system right now, while the fleet is still manageable, so that it works when at scale.

About You

You've spent years elbow-deep in battery systems — you can read a three-line diagram without help, and you know an OEM's manual well enough to push back on their own engineers. You've managed contracts and you've managed people, and you're just as comfortable owning a preventative maintenance program as you are picking up the phone when a site goes down. You'd rather build something from scratch than inherit someone else's system, and you want to own the numbers that come with that.

Key Responsibilities

In year one, expect to be a player-coach: you'll manage the Battery Asset Manager, but you'll also be hands-on yourself — on the phone with OEMs, troubleshooting failures remotely, reviewing alarms, negotiating O&M agreements, visiting sites, escalating warranty claims, and making sure batteries dispatch when they're supposed to. jobs.description_text:
Enterprise Health is standing up a dedicated Client Success Management function to close a long-standing gap: Account Management has been informally absorbing CSM responsibilities alongside its commercial ownership, leaving no clean signal on client health, adoption, or sentiment. The Client Success Manager (CSM) owns the operational client relationship after go-live — driving adoption, generating the health and Voice of Customer signal that informs commercial decisions, and resolving escalations that go beyond a routine support ticket.

The CSM is accountable for the outcomes that justify the account's continued and expanded investment in Enterprise Health, without carrying quota or negotiating contract terms. Account Management remains accountable for the commercial relationship and owns all renewals, in all cases.

Partnering with AI, software, and automation teams, you will build spectral processing, quantification, automated data ingestion, metadata, provenance, and quality-control systems that make characterization outputs reliable, traceable, and useful at scale.
